svg.title: FireHOL Synchronization Sequence
svg.desc: Dark-mode sequence diagram showing periodic FireHOL synchronization, remote commit verification, parallel parsing, resilient failure handling, atomic eBPF map updates, and Prometheus metrics.
svg.text: Periodic trigger → concurrency guard → remote commit check → shallow fetch → parallel parse → zero-copy cache → atomic eBPF map update → metrics
Hourly by default • overlapping executions are skipped safely
Phase 2 — Remote Commit Verification & Shallow Fetch
Cheap OID check avoids parsing and kernel-map reloads when the dataset is unchanged
ALT — remote commit matches loaded commit
Skip parsing, RocksDB ingestion and eBPF map reloads
New commit → shallow fetch (depth=1) + hard reset
Rayon parses .ipset/.netset files while RocksDB + rkyv retains enrichment metadata
Stream entries into RocksDB / rkyv cache
Fail-safe: existing kernel maps remain active and untouched
Phase 4 — Atomic eBPF Map Update & Metrics
Only validated data reaches the kernel maps; metrics summarize the completed synchronization
Update category gauges, rule counters & cron_success_total
Query next scheduled tick and log countdown
Embedded vector brand marks • eBPF eBee • Prometheus • GitHub • Rust • GitHub/README safe
